title: Unit Event — This Moment With You! — Episode6 Figuring Out That Feeling

meta.Event Outline: Leo/need's debut single is taking off. Thanks to the impact of their VIRTUAL SINGER version, their label expresses hopes that the band will create VIRTUAL SINGER versions of all future songs. But Ichika seems hesitant...

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: ...is how you ended up giving me so much, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Talk about a blast from the past...
We went to see that meteor shower after we played as a band for the first time, remember?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I decided to join the brass band because what we did that time was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And you asked us to play again after you had a chance to become a better drummer.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's right!
Then we ended up playing at my house. That was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The reason we decided to form a band together, the reason I was able to get through all those tough moments...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The reason I'm standing here right now...
Is you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Now I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Miku's basically been your hero ever since you were little, huh, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Looking back, I wanted us to play together as a band because I wanted to become just like you, Miku. It was you and your singing that did that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You hear that, Miku-P♪
You're Ichi's role model☆

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, stop.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But you're more than that now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: SEKAI was born, we met you and the others... And you've all helped me in so many different ways.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When we weren't talking to each other or whenever I was writing a song, you kept watching over me and even came over to talk...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was able to keep moving forward because of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, you're more than just my favorite role model now... You're my friend and my senior. I consider you that special...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because I listened to you and the others sing so much back then, it's really fun to have you all perform the songs I make... And it also makes me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And yet...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't understand why I feel so uncomfortable with the idea of putting that out in the world.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I wonder...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aren't you feeling this way because Miku means so much to you, Ichi...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... It's hard to find the right words...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whenever I'm writing a song, it's easy for me to come up with rough demos since only I'm ever going to hear them. But I become way more careful when I know that other people are going to listen to what I'm about to make...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because you care about her so much, you want everyone to hear the songs that present her in the best light, right...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, that might be it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think you sort of just hit the nail on the head, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A part of me doesn't want everyone to hear Miku sing songs that I don't feel are 100% the right choices.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Because I have so many precious memories involving her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Precious memories...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, and now that I think about it, I've always felt that way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When I was writing that song for Hanano and her brother, I thought about all the great memories I had with you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Even with our debut song, I wanted you to sing it because I felt that Saki and I wouldn't have been able to complete it without all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And I'd rather not make you sing any songs that don't make me feel that way...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
Which is why you're not feeling entirely comfortable with this situation.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because there's no guarantee that every song we produce as Leo/need moving forward will do so...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Of course, that's just how I feel.
I know not everyone sees things the same way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Everyone has their own opinion.
For some, loving Miku means making her perform lots of different songs, and some people believe that Miku's voice is meant for certain genres of music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now I understand how you feel, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're not willing to budge regarding this matter. This is the kind of conviction that Mr. Shindo was talking about, which I think is really important for you to have.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Then, I'm sorry...
But if you're all willing to go along...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then I'd like to tell them that we don't want to make a VIRTUAL SINGER version of every song we produce in the future.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I think that's for the best.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But what are you gonna do about that collaboration...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Based on what we just discussed, we should only accept if we're able to produce a song that we want Miku to sing, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (The song for this collaboration is supposed to feel youthful and refreshing.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I feel that Saki and I won't have any issues coming up with a song for Leo/need.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But whether I'll want Miku to sing it is a different question...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry, but I need a little more time to think this over. I feel really bad about making you all wait again...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You know you don't have to apologize, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! This is super important, so it's totally okay to spend a lot of time on it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We'll be more than happy to wait.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I promise to find my answer.
